proposal.summary: FileCloud before 21.3 has a CSRF vulnerability in the CSV user import functionality allowing unauthorized requests to perform that action.
proposal.cwe_quote: the CSV user import functionality is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).

AV.quote: the CSV user import functionality is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).

UI.quote: the CSV user import functionality is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm exploitability: reproduce CSRF by crafting a cross-site request that triggers CSV user import against an authenticated non-admin and observe whether users are created; if confirmed, recommend adding anti-CSRF tokens and requiring same-site checks or re-authentication for user-import actions.
